text: A section of paving outside the ward office has lifted and makes wheelchair access difficult.
दुकानों के सामने सड़क पर गिट्टी जमा है और दोपहिया वाहन फिसल रहे हैं।
A road sign at the roundabout is bent and points toward the wrong exit.
The community water meter is cracked and its display can no longer be read.
पानी की सप्लाई रोज़ सुबह आधे घंटे देर से शुरू होती है।
A public hydrant is spraying water into the road, but nearby buildings still have supply.
Waste collection has been missed for four days along the wholesale market lane.
Apartment ke shared garbage room ka door jam hai aur bins andar nahi le ja paa rahe.
A dead animal has been left beside the public waste collection point since yesterday.
The electrical supply to the neighborhood clinic has been unstable since morning.
A loose overhead wire is hanging low above a lane where people are walking.
The power cabinet outside the community center is locked but its warning light keeps flashing.
A culvert is blocked with branches and water is beginning to collect on the service road.
नाले से बदबू आ रही है, लेकिन पानी सड़क पर नहीं फैल रहा।
The sewer inspection cover is rattling loudly whenever buses pass over it.
The street lamp outside the post office switches off and on throughout the evening.
Park ke walking track par do lamps ka cover toot gaya hai, bulb abhi jal raha hai.
A streetlight timer is set too early, leaving the road dark before sunrise.
The handrail beside the public clinic steps is missing its middle section.
बस अड्डे के पास सार्वजनिक शौचालय का साइनबोर्ड गिरा हुआ है।
A damaged public drinking fountain has sharp metal edges exposed at child height.
